newsitem.title: USA: CME Feb pork bellies drop 2.00-cent limit -trade.
newsitem.headline: CME Feb pork bellies drop 2.00-cent limit -trade.

text.p: CME February pork bellies dropped the 2.00-cent-per-lb daily limit in late trading largely on techical selling, traders said.
After dropping the 2.00-cent limit to 82.050, February moved off the lows but remained sharply lower.
Speculative selling increased late when chart support was penetrated at 82.70 cents, they said.

Lower cash pork belly prices and a bearishly-construed weekly CME storage report guided futures lower early. Tuesday's weekly CME out-of-town cold storage report showed a net-out movement of 247,000 lbs, less than the nearly 2.0 million lbs some analysts expected.
At 1229 CDT, February bellies were off 1.950 at 82.100 cents.
